notes: Forensic and Forensics are both kept so title matching is more forgiving.

Amped Authenticate and Amped FIVE are vendor product names, not keywords: IRS-CI bought two Amped AUTHENTICATE licences on 2026-09-21 under the title 'Software Licensing and Training', and the notice body never uses the word forensic. Multi-word terms go through the phrase filter in term_matches_result, so they cannot admit the unrelated DARPA 'AMPED' programme.
SAM Get Opportunities API matches the title parameter as a title filter, not full description text.
Broad terms like Cyber and IRS will return many results; use --days and review carefully.
